gloss: many; much; a large number; mostly

definitions.gloss: many; much; a large number; the majority
definitions.explanation: A large number or amount of something. Functions as a noun, often followed by の (多くの = many) or used with が/は as a subject meaning 'most' or 'the majority.'

definitions.gloss: mostly; for the most part; in many cases
definitions.explanation: Used adverbially to indicate that something is true in the majority of cases.

examples.japanese: {多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{参加|さんか}した→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{多|おお}く⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{通学|つうがく}→通学：03510_tsuugaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Most of the students use the train to commute to school.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧、⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{不便|ふべん}→不便：01501_fuben⟧だ。
examples.english: In this area, it's inconvenient without a car in most cases.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本人|にほんじん}→日本人：10112_nihonjin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦{語|かた}らない→語る：01930_kataru⟧。
examples.english: Japanese people for the most part don't talk a lot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{休日|きゅうじつ}→休日：03028_kyuujitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: I spend most of my days off at home.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{多|おお}く⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{築|ちく}→築：29014_chiku⟧30{年以上|ねんいじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ものだった。
examples.english: Most of the damaged buildings were over 30 years old.

notes:
The noun/adverb form of ⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧ (many). While ⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧ exists as an adjective, it cannot directly modify a noun — *⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ is ungrammatical. Use {多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ instead.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun: many ~ ({多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: many people)
- ~⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{多|おお}く: most of ~ (⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{多|おお}く: most students)
- {多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧: in many cases
- {多|おお}く⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{語|かた}らない→語る：01930_kataru⟧: not to say much

WATCH OUT:
Learners often write ⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ instead of {多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ or ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧. This is one of the most common errors with ⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧.
